description: This file defines the WorkWeekModel class, which models the workweek structure, including days of the week with their respective integer values. It implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits for serialization within the OrangeHRM leave plugin.

classes.name: WorkWeekModel
classes.description: Represents a model for workweek days with integer properties for each day, used for serialization and API responses within the leave plugin.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the model by initializing it with a WorkWeek entity and setting filter fields for serialization.
